objective: Complete newest-message-first Connect inbox refresh for Personal, Requests, Cluster, Church, and Organization and preserve existing chat behavior for staging Android.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub canonical main inspected at SHA 9aed7d6ad8b6d0ad80aa71daaf66962e9d49de04, with authenticated personal/community inbox RPC definitions read from MAIN project. This is a source baseline only, not evidence of the currently served production OTA or installed staging artifact.
chosenApproach: Stable activity timestamp sorting for every inbox segment, immediate known-room realtime promotion, account-scoped notification/send revision invalidation for first-contact threads, bounded focused refresh and existing chat latest-anchor preservation. No backend change or global message listener. Existing 90-second global unread fallback also signals the inbox on new unread activity or new known thread IDs, without adding another poll. Search is additionally performed on authorized inbox titles and previews within the active tab with no extra backend message search or cross-request results.
selectionRationale: Minimal JS-only modification aligned with existing runtime, RLS, first-view ads and scoped realtime listeners; avoid broad subscriptions and more frequent polling that would increase database load.
alternativeApproaches: Poll all Connect conversations every few seconds (rejected: high egress, request load and battery use).
Subscribe globally to unfiltered direct-message inserts (rejected: user privacy, fanout and RLS performance risk).
Publish directly to production before staging QA (rejected: violates release/runtime/ad-navigation gates).
preserveBehaviors: First-view and inline AdMob rendering/navigation remain unchanged.
Personal and scoped Connect authorization/RLS remain server authoritative.
Outgoing pending or failed sends are never shown as confirmed delivered.
Existing latest-on-open, manual history paging, keyboard and user-controlled scroll anchoring are retained.
PTT push, call handling, notification routing and account isolation remain unchanged.
No production, web or backend changes.
acceptanceChecks: Incoming/outgoing Personal and Request conversation rises to top with latest preview, including after return from chat.
Active Cluster/Church/Organization room rises to top by actual last message time, not room category.
New first-contact push invalidates current user's inbox and revalidates on focus without unfiltered subscriptions.
Read badges remain backend authoritative; no false sent/seen check icons.
Older-history reading does not rebound or force-scroll; composer focus and send still anchor to newest as intended.
All source Jest/Node, TypeScript, Android JS export and ad/tab-nav CI checks PASS at exact RC SHA.
Staging OTA only after isolated installed APK runtime, preview backend, EAS channel separation and device ad/nav/read tests are verified.
Never announce a staging OTA or claim production publication.
Missed foreground push is recovered using the existing unread-count fallback without raising polling frequency.
Search personal, Requests and accessible community rooms by name and message preview without duplicates or cross-tab request leakage.
